title: Saint Sophia Cathedral, Vologda
scope: The standing white masonry Saint Sophia Cathedral in Vologda, including its triple sanctuary apse, curved vault roofs, five metal onion domes and west porch.
limitations: Exterior of the main cathedral. The independently mapped bell tower and nearby churches are separate monuments.
Curved gable subdivisions, secondary ornaments and cross metalwork are approximations based on the cleared photographs.
